The '''Ancient ruins''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]]. After stealing a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] marking the locations of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] vaults from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] hid the map on the ruins.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" />
